title: Policy
description: A named, versioned element of LLM policy: an instructions snippet for CLAUDE.md, a skill, a hook, or settings such as autonomy. Content is a content rendition. Editable while stage is draft; once released it is frozen, and a change is a new version that supersedes it.

name.description: Stable name shared by all versions, e.g. kb-routine or group-review.

version.description: Version number; each release supersedes the previous one with version + 1.

policy_type.description: instructions: a CLAUDE.md snippet; skill: a SKILL.md; hook: Claude Code hook settings (JSON); settings: autonomy and similar (TOML).

stage.description: draft (editable), released (frozen), deprecated (still usable, not recommended).

applies_to.description: Store scopes this policy is meant for: project, home, group ...; empty means any.

order.description: Position of an instructions snippet in CLAUDE.md; lower first.

based_on.description: The policy this one was forked from: builtin:NAME@V or STORE:NAME@V.
